Name: lunakatt's DCBurger style portraits for Shiko NPC
Author: lunakatt
Description:
[size=4]lunakatt's DCBurger Style Portraits for Shiko - New Custom NPC

[size=3]This is a mod in the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's High Res Portrait Mod[/url] for Shiko from moopdrea's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3732]Shiko - New Custom NPC[/url]! [/size]
[/size]


[size=3]Required mods:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API [/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK - Platonymous Toolkit[/url][/size]
[size=4][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3732]Shiko - New Custom NPC[/url][/size][/size]


[size=4]IMPORTANT: [size=3]This version is currently only a replacement mod, so you will be replacing the default pixel portraits with these ones![/size][/size]


Install instructions:
1. Install the required mods listed
2. Extract the folder and move all the PNGs and their .pytk files into the
directory "[CP] Shiko NPC/assets/Image", then replace the files when
prompted.
3. Run the game using SMAPI


Thanks to DCBurger for their beautiful portraits!!
Thanks to moopdrea for the original Shiko mod, and to elfuun and Obamoose who are currently in charge of Shiko :D



If you'd like, consider buying me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lunakatt]Ko-fi[/url]!
